messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin is a prescription medicine.
Gabapentin is used to treat partial seizures.
Gabapentin is used to treat nerve pain from shingles.
Gabapentin is used to treat restless legs syndrome.
The restless legs syndrome treatment is for the Horizant brand only.
Gabapentin may also be prescribed off-label for other conditions.
These conditions include diabetic nerve pain, anxiety, and fibromyalgia.
Gabapentin is thought to work by calming overactive nerve signals in the brain and nervous system.
Gabapentin is an anticonvulsant and nerve pain medication from the drug class gabapentinoids
Gabapentin brand names are Neurontin, Gralise, Horizant, and Relgaabi.
These brand names may not be interchangeable.
Gabapentin is not a federally controlled substance.
Some states classify Gabapentin as Schedule V.
Other states require gabapentin prescriptions to be reported to their prescription drug monitoring program.
This program is known as the PDMP.
Rules on refills and quantity limits vary by state.
The most common side effects of gabapentin are dizziness.
They include drowsiness (somnolence).
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "requires prescriptions to be reported to", "prescription drug monitoring program"]

The relation 'requires prescriptions to be reported to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity mandates that prescriptions for the drug be reported to the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'has status': The subject drug has a specific status or classification specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
